# exo_clutter (Resource)

Manages the Clutter configuration via Set-Clutter.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `enable` (String) Maps to the -Enable parameter.
- `use_custom_routing` (Boolean) Maps to the -UseCustomRouting parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
